title: Rangefinder
description: The viewfinder of a 1960s rangefinder over a crowded club. Put the yellow patch on someone and turn the focus tab until the ghost image slides into the real one, then press: the frame drops onto a contact strip as a black-and-white print, sharp only where you focused.
intent: One optical instrument finished to the edge: a coincident-image rangefinder whose split patch is driven by a hand-built depth map of the scene, so focusing is real parallax and every print carries the depth of field you chose.
